signs.text: ELI'S GARAGE — the Bench, and everything he left you.
THE BUNKS — yours is the one by the wall.
THE INFIRMARY — patch up before you ride the lift.
COMMAND — Warden Boone's post. Knock first.
THE MESS — eat when the line's short.
OHMSTEAD COMMONS — the heart of the colony.
COMMS & ARCHIVE — the Downtowns, when the signal holds.
THE WORKS — water, power, the air we breathe.
STORES — rations, nodes, salvage. Chit required.
THE YARD — the dig face, and the cart to the surface line.

npcs.name: Grandma Mabel
lines: Built from Eli's parts, woken at Eli's bench. That makes it family now. Mind it well.
Your grandfather could coax a song out of a dead radio. Banjo still hums it, some nights.
Boone wants you topside at first light. Come back to me, you hear? The both of you.

npcs.name: Cass
lines: They won't let me up the lift. 'Too young,' Boone says. You're barely older than me!
Bring me back something from the surface. A bottle cap — anything that saw the sky.
Everyone's spooked by the night signal. Pretend you're not, and I will too.

npcs.name: Warden Boone
lines: First light, topside. Grandma's cache won't haul itself, and the lift won't wait on nerves.
Stay current up there. The grass hides more than rust these days.
You're Eli's blood. That buys you one mistake. Spend it well.

npcs.name: Medic Sela
lines: Come back in one piece and I keep my record clean. Deal?
Your Ohm takes a hit, you bring it here. Don't let it run on a cracked core.

npcs.name: Cook Holt
lines: Ration stew again. It sticks to your ribs, which is the kindest thing I can say.
Eat before the lift. Nobody fights well on an empty tank.

npcs.name: the Rationer
lines: A chit gets you a node and a day of light. No chit, no argument.
Salvage what you can topside. Stores runs thin the deeper we dig.

npcs.name: Lookout Dell
lines: Cart runs up the surface line at the hour. Miss it, you walk.
I watch the dig face so it doesn't watch us back. Quiet today. Mostly.

npcs.name: Tess, on the pumps
lines: Air and water. Lose either and the rest of this stops mattering fast.
Eli kept these old pumps singing. I just try not to let them choke.
